description: This file defines a final class EventConstants that contains constant string values used throughout the Event API, such as endpoint names and content types, as well as a utility method to check for empty notification content types.

classes.name: EventConstants
classes.description: A utility class holding constant values related to event endpoints and content types, with a static method to identify empty notification types.

methods.name: isEmptyNotificationType
